en: Black‑and‑white view of a large late‑19th/early‑20th‑century hotel or grand café with three main stories and a mansard roof. The façade has tall windows with decorative awnings on the ground floor, suggesting a restaurant or café; in front of it are many outdoor tables and chairs arranged under leafless or early‑spring trees, creating a park‑like terrace. A few people are seated at the tables. In the background there are hills with scattered houses. The overall look is that of a European spa‑town or resort hotel.
